dataset: Revelio Labs Job Postings (postings_cosmos) - New York City metropolitan area, posted 2025
period_definition: calendar date of post_date (posting first seen), in the table's date convention
source: Wharton Research Data Services (WRDS), Harvard University subscription

field_notes.salary_predicted: true = Revelio-imputed salary; this pull keeps only false (posted salaries)
field_notes.expected_hires: Revelio prediction, not a stated opening count
field_notes.role_k1500_v2, role_k17000_v3: Revelio role taxonomy; pulled, not used for the primary feasibility rule
field_notes.metro_area: finest location field in the pull; no city or borough
field_notes.company: employer name as Revelio normalizes it; rcid is the employer key
field_notes.country, state: pulled alongside the filters; constant within the extract
field_notes.remote_type: values: Fully In Office 2,954,475; Fully Remote 283,853; Partially In Office 32,931; Remote In Territory 556; Temporarily Remote 140. Analysis keeps the first and third.

license_and_usage.vendor_approval: Revelio Labs (research@reveliolabs.com), 2026-11-09: use in protected LLM environments (HUIT AI Sandbox) permitted.
license_and_usage.pending: HUIT API Platform (OpenAI Direct) route: awaiting HUIT confirmation of the same no-training agreement, then Revelio confirmation.

our_usage_rules: Do not commit or redistribute the extract or any posting-level rows; keep data/ git-ignored. The SQL query may be committed.
Do not share the extract with anyone outside Harvard's WRDS subscription; each teammate must use their own WRDS account.
May only use data in approved protected LLM instances.
Publish aggregates and synthetic market files only; no row with a job_id or rcid beside a salary.
